<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Complaint" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Complaint decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Refund" name="Reimbursement"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer feedback"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Files complaint" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Notifies customer of decision" sourceRef="Task_Notify" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Refund" sourceRef="Task_Reimburse" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provides feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_Feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Handle customer complaint" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogAssign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Resolve</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Feedback</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Relevant department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Assess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Notify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundApproved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Financial team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Reimburse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Complaint" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogAssign" name="Log and assign complaint"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assess" name="Assess complaint validity and refund justification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Notify" name="Notify customer of decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved?" default="Flow_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Reimburse" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Merge" name="Continue to resolution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Resolve" name="Mark complaint resolved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Complaint" name="Complaint resolved"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Feedback" name="Handle customer feedback" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Feedback" name="Customer feedback received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Feedback" messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordFeedback" name="Record customer feedback"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Feedback" name="Feedback recorded"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_1" sourceRef="Start_Feedback" targetRef="Task_RecordFeedback"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_2" sourceRef="Task_RecordFeedback" targetRef="End_Feedback"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="Start_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogAssign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_LogAssign" targetRef="Task_Assess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Assess" targetRef="Task_Notify"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Notify" targetRef="Gateway_RefundApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundApproved" targetRef="Task_Reimburse">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${refundApproved == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Rejected" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundApproved" targetRef="Gateway_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reimburse" sourceRef="Task_Reimburse" targetRef="Gateway_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Resolve" sourceRef="Gateway_Merge" targetRef="Task_Resolve"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="Task_Resolve" targetRef="End_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
